citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
It has been greater than 6 months since the last semi annual review of the facilities. The last documented review was
recorded on 14 November 2025. Not conducting an inspection of the animal facilities on a semi annual basis does not
allow the IACUC to determine if the facility has been maintained in a manner to protect the welfare of the animals. It is the
responsibility of the IACUC to conduct semi annual inspections of the research facility's animal areas to ensure they are
maintained in a manner that protects the health and safety of the animals.
To be corrected by 31 October 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
HARVEY KENT, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
